description: needsTopUp from the API is a topup gate even without credit fields. A customer who holds a plan is not told to pick one, and auto-recharge being off is named.

result.message: Included usage is exhausted. [Add credits](https://checkout.conformance.test/s/2) to add credits (expires in 15 minutes), or call the `account` tool with view: 'topup'. Auto-recharge is off — call the `account` tool with view: 'account' to turn it on and avoid this next time.
